text.p: Egypt's Pachin/Paints and Chemical Industries announced on Friday it would give shareholders a 6.5 pound dividend per share for the financial year 1995/6.
Pachin, which published the dividend announcement in the newspapers, had promised investors 5.5 pounds a share.
Earlier this year, the partly-privatised but state-run firm split its one million shares to stimulate trading in the stock and currently has 10 million shares.
The Cairo stock exchange was closed on Friday for the weekend but Pachin's shares ended unchanged on Thursday at 140 pounds.
The state also announced that it would sell part of its stake in the firm to international investors through a global depositary receipt offering in January.
